summary: Let a shared-storage VM start on a single-host pool: VM inventory publication is skipped when the host has no pool peer record, while an invalid record still fails closed. API impact: none.

guide.reason: Restores the documented VM power workflow on single-host pools; no instructions change.

api.reason: API impact: none. The vm-power command, result and the Core peer inventory route are unchanged; a host with no peer record simply has no master to publish to.

roadmap.reason: Bug fix within the current storage milestone.

state.reason: No durable state added or changed; the VM owner record and start permit remain written locally by the existing single-host path.

verification.method: Regression test fails before the fix (publish refused on a standalone host) and passes after; an invalid peer record still refuses; go vet and go test -race ./internal/agent pass. Not re-run on a lab host.
